title: Kissed Dutch Rigatoni Casserole
description: A dairy-free friendly, gooey Dutch dish featuring rigatoni, perfect for meal prep. It's a hearty, comforting casserole perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375F. Prepare a 9x13 inch baking dish with non-stick spray.
Cook the rigatoni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook the chicken sausage over medium-high heat until browned. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the diced onion and minced garlic until softened. Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start browning.
Add the cooked rigatoni, chicken sausage, and almond milk to the skillet. Stir to combine, then transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle the nutritional yeast over the top of the casserole, and drizzle with olive oil. Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned and the casserole is heated through.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Cover and refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months. To reheat, thaw overnight in the fridge and then bake at 350F for 20-25 minutes, or until warmed through.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
